reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "5d147a3ae665053ed4ec6f77c994540abf9ce40e: chore(appset)!: always apply nested selectors", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: ApplicationSets with nested selectors may now produce a different set of Applications, because those selectors are always applied.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, check ApplicationSets that use selectors inside nested generators, and confirm the Applications they will generate.

proposed.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 makes a breaking change so the ApplicationSet controller always applies nested selectors.
